title: inside this ideal the bare coin sorts as the scaled one — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
inside this ideal the bare coin sorts as the scaled one, declared in src/proof/split.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

(tokens.filter (fun t => t % 2 == 0)) = (tokens.filter (fun t => t % coinStep == 0)) ∧ tokens.all (fun t => (t % 2 == 0) == (t % coinStep == 0))

\{\, t \in \mathrm{tokens} \mid t \bmod 2 = 0 \,\} = \{\, t \in \mathrm{tokens} \mid t \bmod \mathrm{coinStep} = 0 \,\} \land \forall t \in \mathrm{tokens},\; t \bmod 2 = 0 = t \bmod \mathrm{coinStep} = 0
